title: Create a fully tested multi-file Markdown Parser and Generator
description:
In the workspace, create a Node.js ESM package that parses Markdown strings into an AST (Abstract Syntax Tree) and can generate HTML from the AST. It must support Headings (H1-H6), Bold, Italic, Links, and Paragraphs. Features:
1. Parser module (`src/parser.js`) that takes markdown string and returns AST.
2. Generator module (`src/generator.js`) that takes AST and returns HTML string.
3. Main entry point (`src/index.js`) exposing `render(markdownString)`.
4. CLI script (`bin/cli.js`) that reads a markdown file and outputs HTML to stdout.
Requirements:
- Node ESM format.
- Use `node --test` for comprehensive unit tests of each AST node type.
- Pass all tests.
acceptanceCriteria: package.json is ESM and includes a bin property
parser.js and generator.js are implemented correctly
node --test passes completely with coverage of basic markdown elements
